trials.role: Auranofin with sirolimus for recurrent ovarian cancer
Auranofin monotherapy safety in healthy adults
trials.outcome: Fifteen healthy adults received oral auranofin 6 mg daily for 7 days. Seven of 15 had treatment-emergent adverse events. Reported events were mild, including gastrointestinal symptoms in three and transient platelet-count decreases in two. No serious adverse events, deaths or withdrawals were reported. This was a fixed-dose study.
